Hero.title: SHRIDHYAN
Hero.headline: Learn the Ancient Healing Wisdom of the Atharvaveda — Backed by 50 Years of Practical Experience
Hero.subheadline: Learn authentic Vedic bio-healing based on the Atharvaveda (Kanda 4, Sukta 13). Discover traditional practices involving the hands, breath, and life energy, rooted in five decades of spiritual practice and practical experience.
Hero.quote: “50 years of Himalayan penance — authentic cultivation”

Guide.label: Meet Your Guide • Authority & Trust
Guide.title: Rooted in 50 Years of Dedicated Himalayan Tapasya
Guide.subtitle: Param Pujya Swami Ji Maharaj — Guide & Founder of Shridhyan Ashram
Guide.desc: Today's world is searching for authentic spiritual guides who possess not only theoretical knowledge but also decades of direct practical experience. Your teacher's 50 years of continuous spiritual practice, in-depth exploration of the Atharvaveda, and direct results helping thousands of seekers form the unbreakable foundation of this sacred transmission.
Guide.pillar1_desc: Fifty years of continuous sadhana and contemplation of the Atharvaveda (Kanda 4, Sukta 13), exploring traditional Vedic energy and life-force principles.
Guide.pillar2_desc: Documented experiences and authentic testimonials from thousands who have experienced transformative physical, mental, and emotional well-being.
Guide.pillar3_desc: Learn traditional sacred concepts such as Shivabhimarshana (healing through touch) and Vata-Bheshaja (vital breath and life energy), taught with deep ethical responsibility.

Benefits.label: Key Course Benefits
Benefits.title: Traditional Wisdom for Personal & Professional Life
Benefits.subtitle: Carefully organized into three dimensions of personal well-being, traditional practice, and professional development.
Benefits.cat1_b1_desc: Learn traditional breathing practices involving Prana and Apana to support relaxation and manage everyday stress and fatigue.
Benefits.cat1_b2_desc: Explore traditional Vedic concepts of life energy and develop a deeper, intuitive understanding of your body's natural restorative responses.
Benefits.cat1_b3_desc: Practice meditation, mantra sound recitation, and quietude to foster deep emotional balance and mental tranquility.
Benefits.cat2_b1_desc: Explore traditional hand gestures, palm and finger awareness, and the profound significance of Mantras 6 and 7 (Ayam Me Hasto Bhagavan).
Benefits.cat2_b2_desc: Learn authentic mantra recitation, focused intention, and traditional practices for personal reflection and well-being.
Benefits.cat2_b3_desc: Explore simple, grounded breathing, mindfulness, and relaxation routines that support general comfort and vitality.
Benefits.cat3_b1_desc: Yoga teachers, Reiki practitioners, Ayurveda professionals, and wellness coaches can integrate traditional Vedic practices into their professional scope.
Benefits.cat3_b2_desc: Cultivate greater self-awareness, deepen your meditation into profound silence, and connect directly with Himalayan lineage transmission.

Curriculum.label: Step-by-Step Curriculum
Curriculum.title: 5 Progressive Stages of Learning
Curriculum.subtitle: Students clearly understand how the course progresses from foundational sacred phonetics to guided experiential application.
Curriculum.m1_desc: Introduction to the seven sacred mantras of Atharvaveda (Kanda 4, Sukta 13), traditional pronunciation, their meaning, and their foundational role in Vedic practice.
Curriculum.m2_desc: Explore traditional hand practices, awareness of the palms and fingers, and the sacred mantra 'Ayam Me Hasto Bhagavan' (These hands of mine are blessed).
Curriculum.m3_desc: Learn foundational breathing techniques and explore the traditional concepts of Prana (vital breath) and Apana (grounding energy) for systemic balance.
Curriculum.m4_desc: Introduction to traditional touch-based practices, energetic awareness, appropriate boundaries, and safe, respectful practice.
Curriculum.m5_desc: Explore documented experiences, practical demonstrations, and supervised guided exercises based on the instructor's five decades of experience.

Positioning.title: Clear Positioning: Traditional Wisdom for Modern Life
Positioning.text: The course explores traditional concepts involving breath, sound, meditation, touch, and personal awareness. These practices are intended for educational and general wellness purposes and are not a substitute for medical diagnosis or clinical treatment. The material is presented transparently, responsibly, and without exaggerated claims.

FAQ.label: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.title: Clear Guidance for Prospective Students
FAQ.q1: Who is eligible to join the 7-Day Foundation Course?
FAQ.a1: The course is open to all sincere seekers, meditation practitioners, yoga teachers, wellness professionals, and beginners seeking authentic Vedic life-energy practices. No prior Sanskrit knowledge is required.
FAQ.q2: What is the course format and schedule?
FAQ.a2: The course combines structured live guided sessions, daily practice assignments, and downloadable mantra guides. Both interactive online cohorts and in-person Himalayan Ashram retreats in Mathali, Uttarkashi are scheduled.
FAQ.q3: What makes this course unique compared to other healing courses?
FAQ.a3: It is directly rooted in the authentic text of the Atharvaveda (Kanda 4, Sukta 13) and backed by 50 years of continuous lived practice and direct results helping thousands of individuals by Swami Ji Maharaj.
FAQ.q4: Is this course a substitute for medical treatment?
FAQ.a4: No. These practices are traditional Vedic educational and wellness disciplines designed for relaxation, stress management, and spiritual cultivation, not medical diagnosis or clinical cure.
FAQ.q5: Why is each cohort limited to 25 participants?
FAQ.a5: To maintain exceptional quality of instruction, allow direct feedback on mantra pronunciation and hand awareness, and give every student personal attention.

About.title: Welcome to an Ancient Tapobhoomi
About.description_1: The sacred sanctuary of Shridhyan is situated in Mathali, Uttarkashi amidst the serene heights of the Himalayas, consecrated under the guidance of Param Pujya Swami Ji Maharaj.
About.description_2: This sacred ground is consecrated by the silent sadhana of Himalayan rishis and seekers of truth. Free from artificial discord, here flows only the pure mountain air, peaceful shade of deodar and pine groves, and the perpetual grace of the Guru lineage.
About.badge_desc: A consecrated Himalayan hermitage preserving traditional meditation practices, inner silence, and experiential yogic contemplation.
About.quote: “In the lap of penance and natural peace, the soul is reborn.”

Philosophy.description: Living in conscious cadence with Himalayan serenity, mountain stillness, birdsong, and the natural cycles of dawn and dusk is not an ascetic austerity — it is the deepest portal to inner quietude.
Philosophy.description2: Here, priority is given to natural resources, Vedic lifestyle, and the quiet Himalayan atmosphere to simplify life and awaken higher consciousness. Nature itself is the primary guide.

Tapobhoomi.label: Himalayan Tapobhoomi • Mathali (Uttarkashi)
Tapobhoomi.title: The Spiritual Heritage of an Ancient Tapobhoomi
Tapobhoomi.description: Rooted in authentic tradition, Shridhyan stands upon Himalayan ground revered for deep contemplation, silence, and communion with the eternal.
Tapobhoomi.card1_desc: Nestled in the holy valley of Uttarkashi, Mathali offers a supremely serene and spiritually charged atmosphere for meditation, silence, and self-inquiry.
Tapobhoomi.card2_desc: The natural seclusion of the ashram creates an ideal environment to turn inward — for self-study, deep contemplation, and the practice of meditation.
Tapobhoomi.card3_desc: The pristine Himalayan air and the serene canopy of cedar and pine forests help quiet the restless mind and draw consciousness inward.

GuruParampara.label: Tradition & Sacred Transmission
GuruParampara.title: Guru Parampara & Divine Grace
GuruParampara.description: Shridhyan functions as a living channel of sacred transmission, awakened through the subtle spiritual presence and guidance of the revered Guru lineage.
GuruParampara.guru1_desc: Himalayan Yogi and revered spiritual inspiration in the lineage of authentic tapasya.
GuruParampara.guru2_desc: Guide and inspiration behind Shridhyan Ashram, dedicated to authentic meditation and Himalayan tapasya.
GuruParampara.guru3_desc: Guiding seekers on the inner path of meditation, yogic disciplines, and devotional contemplative life.
GuruParampara.quote: “In the Guru-Shishya tradition, tapasya, discipline, and direct inner experience form the spiritual foundation. Guru-kripa is the eternal guiding light of the inner journey.”

Silence.label: ॥ Maunam Sarvartha Sadhanam ॥
Silence.title: “Here, Silence is a Sadhana”
Silence.description: Words cease where pure presence begins. In Shridhyan, silence is not merely the absence of speech, but the luminous awakening of internal awareness.

Courses.c2_desc: Comprehensive training in classical meditation techniques, yogic discipline, and teaching methodology.
Courses.c3_desc: Authentic sadhana, mantras, and contemplative worship in the sacred Shri Vidya tradition.
